XHelpers Pro 1.0.30 (48)
- Dictation settings are reorganized into seven panes: General, Voice & Language, Writing & Review, Words & Formatting, AI Review, Apps, and Privacy & Usage. Search opens the section that holds a setting. - Your Dictionary and each app's word list now share one editor. Resetting an app's settings keeps its words and what Pro has learned. - Settings say what an option needs and why it is paused, and a saved choice that is paused can be turned off where it is shown. An amount that can't be saved stays beside its field. - One tap of the Dictation key now works in every Review panel that opens by itself. - When GPT-6 Luna takes words out, the text keeps one space, and "Use original" brings back exactly what you said. A respelling such as "GPT6" to "GPT-6" now goes in by default. - The Dictation settings window and its sidebar grow for longer translations, so pane titles stay on one line. - Updated translations in all 25 supported languages.
